component.name: ESP32 Multi Flash Manager
component.summary: Parallel ESP32 firmware flashing for manufacturing and lab benches

description.p: ESP32 Multi Flash Manager is a desktop tool for flashing firmware to many ESP32 boards in parallel, built around esptool. It supports per-device configuration, live flashing progress and logs, firmware profiles, reusable projects (.emfm), flash history, and batch editing of device settings.
